category: Smoked meat and smoked meat products (general limit)
Smoked fishery products (general limit), except products listed in 5.1.8
scope_note: For fish, applies to muscle meat; whole fish if eaten whole. For crustaceans, muscle meat from appendages/abdomen (cephalothorax excluded).

category: Smoked sprats/canned smoked sprats, smoked Baltic herring <=14cm, katsuobushi, bivalve molluscs, heat-treated meat products (special-case general limit)
